items.title: Critical GitLab AI Gateway Vulnerability Enables Remote Code Execution Attacks
items.description: GitLab has released urgent security updates for a critical AI Gateway vulnerability that could allow authenticated attackers to execute commands remotely. Tracked as CVE-2026-90970, the flaw carries a CVSS score of 9.9 and affects self-hosted deployments used to support GitLab Duo AI features.
